title: Ordinary global Hom-complex cohomology computes homotopy classes naturally
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let A be its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let L and M vary over integer-indexed cochain complexes in A [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Write Γ = Hom_A(R,-) for global sections, applied termwise, and q for passage to the homotopy category (chain maps modulo homotopy). There is an additive natural isomorphism H⁰(Γ(Hom•(L,M))) ≅ Hom_K(A)(L,M), contravariant in L and covariant in M, where the sheaf Hom complex is [def-pur-hom-complex]. The left side is ordinary complex cohomology, not right-derived global sections. No boundedness, K-flatness or K-injectivity is assumed.

source.place: Equation 0A8Z (sites-cohomology-equation-global-cohomology-hom-complex), degree zero; global computation in Lemma 08JA. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A8Z and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JA.

proof.text: Take the product projections of the Hom complex once. Their limit property gives an additive equivalence between global sections in degree n and ordinary cochains. Use explicit equations for the resulting equivalence, with local irreducibility of the equivalence construction, to avoid repeatedly reducing its large data. The differential and map projection formulas prove compatibility with differentials and naturality in both complexes. All module and coefficient universes are max c v r.

Apply zeroth homology. Mathlib HomComplex.leftHomologyData and CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv, followed by shiftFunctorZero, identify external Hom homology with homotopy-category morphisms. On cocycle representatives the map is q of the chain map; LeftHomologyMapData proves pre/postcomposition naturality. Compose with the preceding complex isomorphism and assemble NatIso.ofComponents.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_global_homotopyOfUniverses
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R
    let Γ := preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op (SheafOfModules.unit R₀))
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} R₀) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    Nonempty ((Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R)) ⋙
        Γ.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r} (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0) ≅
      q.op.prod q ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj preadditiveCoyoneda)
